description: Models load at app open (9ij.17 ModelWarmup). The glasses already say when they're loading; also say when they're done (e.g. a short 'Captions ready' notice on the idle page and a transient line while recording), and show a failure if a model can't load. Integrate nkprtuuv (9ij.17) and lnuwmlyo (9ij.16) onto 9ij.15 and the Node live harness (9ij.20), resolving engines.ts/services.ts conflicts, and verify with pnpm check and the live harness.

comments.text: Done in jj revision xlqmkkqqutvt (stack: xttmqlzt -> lnuwmlyo 9ij.16 -> nkprtuuv 9ij.17 -> vynvuqzk 9ij.20 harness -> oktyqwsl 9ij.21 -> xlqmkkqqutvt). pnpm check 66 tests; pnpm test:live 4 tests (real models): loading line precedes first caption, 'Captions ready.' follows.

title: Glasses announce when caption models finish loading; integrate warmup, VAD fix and harness
